scope: TypeScript source files included by the selected project or project-service configuration

applicability: Rule enabled in TYPED_RULES and file successfully parsed with type information

negative: export function safe(value: number): number { return value + 1; }

cases.rationale: Assignment from any bypasses type checking at the receiving boundary.
An any argument bypasses a declared parameter contract.

cases.rationale: Calling any does not establish a callable target.
